test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Survival
solution:
Here the correct answer is** Existence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym for** "Survival" **is **option 2, "Existence."**
 
• **Survival **refers to **the ability of an organism to remain alive or continue to exist**, while **existence **refers to** the fact or state of being alive or present in the world.**
 
 
• For example, in the passage, it is mentioned that Phytoplankton use sunlight to create chemical energy which is essential for their survival. Here, survival refers to the ability of Phytoplankton to continue to exist and thrive in their environment. Similarly, in the context of the passage, the phrase "essential for their existence" could be used instead of "essential for their survival" to convey the same meaning.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "Change,"** is not a synonym of "Survival" as it refers to the act of becoming different or the result of becoming different. For example, the passage mentions that oceans will **change **their color due to climate **change**.
 
• **Option 3, "Close," **is also not a synonym of "Survival" as it refers to the state of being near in space or time. For example, "The deadline for the project is getting **close**."
 
• **Option 4, "Start,"** is not a synonym of "Survival" as it refers to the beginning of something. For example, "I will **start **my new job next week."
